The exact frozen v0.1.0-rc.2 commit d17605686768832226da55090a33b28888bfab35 (deterministic archive SHA-256 11a215f24da98ec1cc012fd8b8fefde8f8be6264fc520d80fa7a1c92f2837c66) completed the versioned 900-second Linux amd64 Clang 18 ASan/UBSan/libFuzzer campaign with an available external symbolizer. It executed 2,344,549 inputs in 901 seconds, reached 15,623 covered edges and 42,341 features, and produced no crash artifact, sanitizer error, timeout, or slow input. The full log and evolved corpus remain privately retained and hash-bound. The first launch failed before fuzzing on a container-name conflict and was rerun unchanged; both logs are retained. This is evidence for this exact build, not universal parser safety.

PyPI xisf 0.9.7 replayed every committed fixture on the frozen v0.1.0-rc.2 commit through its documented public API: nine third-party-produced fixtures matched exact decoded-pixel SHA-256, and the mmxisf-written fixtures matched their file hashes, stated values, Properties and pixel identities, except the Revision 1 multi-subblock fixture, which this package cannot decode (documented LIMITED result; native PixInsight evidence covers it). This is exact-fixture black-box evidence; the package is not a project dependency and no implementation source was inspected. The 2026-09-21 record remains as the earlier run.

Candidate X measurements exist for Apple M2 macOS arm64 (writer median 395 MiB/s, host budget >=250 met), Ryzen 5 5500U Linux amd64 (median 89.7 MiB/s) and native Windows Server 2025 amd64/MSVC (median 133.2 MiB/s) in docs/performance-runs/2026-10-06-rc2-macos-linux.json and docs/quality-runs/2026-10-06-rc2-windows-amd64-msvc.json. The gate stays LIMITED because the low-copy row reader rejects the globally shuffled multi-subblock benchmark profile by documented Revision 1 policy (no row-reader timing exists), and Linux and Windows writer throughput is about 27-35% below the v0.1.0-rc.1-era checkpoints without root-cause isolation; no portable SLA or cross-host ranking is claimed. Promotion to PASS needs an explicit owner acceptance of these observations.

Partial: the owner accepted OpenSSL 3.6.4 for v0.1.0 on 2026-10-06 with an API-scoped disposition (digest primitives only; official list https://openssl-library.org/news/vulnerabilities/), and the pinned-vcpkg binary SBOMs of candidate X for macOS, Linux and native MSVC all bind the same five reviewed dependencies (docs/security-audits/2026-10-06-rc2-advisory-review.json). The gate stays NOT_TESTED because Expat 2.8.5 (2026-09-22, security release for CVE-2026-93990, UTF-16 decoding) postdates the pinned Expat 2.8.4 and needs an owner disposition: either an API-scoped acceptance (the parser is created with a UTF-8 encoding override and non-UTF-8 declarations are rejected, a source reading not yet backed by a test) or a new candidate with the pin bumped. The review must also be refreshed immediately before publication. The v0.1.0-rc.1 review is historical.
